thread:
anya (PM): Heads-up: planning a micro A/B rollout for model-v2 quant next Tue. This thread to agree guardrails for tenant-aware slices, metric gates, and the rollback SLA.

jess (Product): Proposal: split by region then tenant class. Phase 1: 3% traffic globally but respect tenant opt-outs. Phase 2: 20% regional ramps (EU/APAC first), then 100% after 48h stable windows. Also run an A/B holdout cohort for revenue-sensitive tenants.

sam (Eng): Implementation notes: we'll use feature flags with the naming convention `ff/route/model-v2/<region>/<slice>` and a per-tenant override list. Balancer will apply weighted routing; if tenant in denylist -> always model-v1. I'll add a safety TTL on flags for auto-expire.

jess (Product): Can we attach a prompted promptset sample to the canary so we run live A/B metrics + offline eval? Need churn detection, hallucination rate, latency, and cost/unit.

lina (Data): I'll seed a holdout sample: 2k prompts (P0+random) per window and produce nightly diffs. Pass criteria: semantic-match delta <= 1.5% and hallucination increase < 0.5%. If either fails, the canary is flagged `needs-review`.

marc (SRE): Ops constraints: automated rollback if any of the following within a 10m window: p95 latency +250ms, 5xx spike >0.75%, or error budget burn rate >3x. Rollback must complete <30s end-to-end and notify #prod-alerts + oncall pager. We'll test kill path in staging.

release-bot: Created rollout job: rj-2026-03-176666. Initial slice: global-3pct, holdout cohort: tenants:vip-alpha,vip-beta.

sam (Eng): Quick-kill CLI for oncall: 
```
# immediate revert to model-v1 for a flag
redwoodctl flags set ff/route/model-v2/eu/global-3pct --percent 0 --force --reason "auto-rollback"
```
This triggers traffic revert and emits an event to the runbook.

anya (PM): Checklist before any ramp: dashboard with live diffs, alerts wired, opt-out list validated, docs for private deployments (no telemetry exfil), runbook link, and SRE sign-off on kill-path. Who signs off on quality?

lina (Data): I'll be quality owner for the canary signals and will post pass/fail by end of each 12h window.

jess (Product): Product will own customer comms and holdout cohort decisions. We'll also create a short FAQ for customers about tenant opt-outs.

marc (SRE): I'll run the kill-path simulation in staging today and post timings. If <30s, we mark as green for the SLA. Also adding an automated fallback to model-v1 when the release-bot detects missing heartbeats from model-v2 instances.

sam (Eng): Note: prefix cache warmup plan: pre-seed top 2k prefixes for VIP tenants and top 10k global prefixes for EU. This reduces cold-start noise in metrics.

release-bot: Phase 1 canary executed in staging: simulated rollback time = 21s.

anya (PM): Final: meeting tomorrow 08:30 PST for sign-off. If Lina flags `needs-review`, we stop the ramp and require human approval to continue. Otherwise, proceed with staged ramps. :thumbsup:
